lines: Jis dil pe naaz tha mujhe, woh dil nahin raha
couplets.en: The heart I once took pride in is gone.
I can no longer offer love my plea.

lines: Marne ki ai dil aur hi tadbeer kar ke main
couplets.en: Find another way to die, my heart.
I am no longer worthy of the hand that would slay me.
I can no longer offer love my plea.

lines: Waa kar diye hain shauq ne band-e-niqaab-e-husn
couplets.en: Longing has undone the ties of beauty's veil.

lines: Ghair az nigaah ab koi haa'il nahin raha
couplets.en: Only my gaze now stands between us.
I can no longer offer love my plea.

lines: Bedaad-e-ishq se nahin darta magar Asad
couplets.en: I do not fear love's cruelty, Asad, though something has changed.

lines: Jis dil pe naaz tha mujhe, woh dil nahin raha
couplets.en: The heart I once took pride in is gone.
I can no longer offer love my plea.
